finding.text: Deliverable 4 has no live proof. `Servex/process-live.mjs` is written, but the session log's last line (session.jsonl, 05:23:59Z) still says "Next: review, merge, restart Servex, re-run the live Haiku process", and nothing in the task folder shows a passing run or a run with a Servex restart mid-run. The script only tells you to restart Servex by hand (process-live.mjs:3); the restart case is not part of the rerunnable test the brief asked for.

There is no `report.md` in the task folder. The brief asks for one screen that shows each deliverable, its proof, the command to rerun it, `--report` output for this session and for `e00f55c9`, the formula chosen and why, the actual cost, and the list of what was closed. A fresh agent can't tell from the folder what landed and what is left.

The docs are stale. `core/Session/readme.md:139` and `:146` still say completion is the share of root tasks in state `complete` (`{done:30,total:132,…,completion:0.227}`), but `Task.completion_score` is now a recursive mean that also counts child sessions and counted prompts. The diff touches none of `core/Task/readme.md`, `core/Session/readme.md` or `core/Task/doc/process.md`, even though `Server/session-query.mjs:42` sends readers to the Session readme for the completion report. `ai/sessions/doc/data/record-spec.md:53` doesn't list `--report`, `--recent` or `--root` either.

Bug 3b, a spawned agent's task left `running` with `completed_at` set after it lands, has no fix in the diff. `Asks.js:120` only stops an ask from being marked landed without proof. The `from`/`id` move fix (`page_tools.js:record_file`) and the child linking (`Agents.js:1124` claim, `SessionFolders.adopt_nested`) are present and tested.

`Servex/agents/page_tools.js` `record_file` tests `/^d{4}$/`, a literal "dddd", where `/^\d{4}$/` was meant. It only works because the `existsSync` check on the same line catches year folders. Fix the backslash so the guard means what it says.

The mismatch the brief names (64.8% vs 56.7% vs 49.9%) is explained only in the CLI's `not used` line (`session-query.mjs:147`). The "why this formula" the brief asks for should be in the report and the readme, with the new number for `e00f55c9`.

`completion.test.mjs:549` builds its "independent" recomputation from `c.completion_score() === 1` for prompts, so prompt scoring is checked against itself. `Server/session-query.test.mjs` does recompute it from raw JSONL, which covers the ask, but the unit test overstates its independence.

`ProcessRunner.close_out` calls `task_loop.close_task` on process completion. The log says process-cleanup was messaged, but its answer isn't recorded in this folder, so the agreement the brief asks for can't be confirmed.
`ProcessRunner.js:6` puts `const OPEN` between two import lines. That's legal, but it reads oddly; move it below the imports.
